global: A steaming bowl of shoyu ramen broth, rich and amber, cradles tender noodles and crisp bok choy. Thinly sliced scallions and shredded daikon crown the surface, all nestled in a pristine white bowl under warm, inviting light.

regions.background: The table surface is light wood grain, smooth, with visible texture and natural patterns.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with smooth, glossy surface and slightly raised, rounded rim.
regions.soup: The shoyu (soy sauce) broth is golden-brown, textured with egg ribbons and vegetables, topped with green onions and shredded white garnish.
